figurative_meaning_en: to subdue; to intimidate or show consequences
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোকে দেখিয়ে দেব যে কী হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: If you hit me, I'll show you some fun.
I'll show you what happens if you mess with me.
note: Often used in phrases like 'মজা দেখিয়ে দেওয়া' to imply retaliation or demonstrating consequences.
